adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, after `const credentialKey = credential.key as ...`, the diff adds an unconditional refresh-token request (`fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)`) and then unconditionally updates the credential row via `await prisma.credential.update({ where: { id: credential.id }, data: { key: ... } })` before returning `new jsforce.Connection(...)`. There is no check for token expiry or “auth failure” path shown; the refresh/update happen every time this code path runs, which can create avoidable load/rate-limit pressure and concurrent updates to the same credential row.
